title: js_anki: verified Anki deck for JS built-ins
objective: A single command builds an .apkg of flip-and-self-grade cards for LeetCode-relevant JS Array/String methods and related idioms, where every card example has been executed in Node and matches its stated result.
acceptance_criteria: python -m python_pkg.js_anki build exits 0 and writes the .apkg
A deliberately wrong expected value makes the build exit non-zero
The .apkg imports into desktop Anki with the expected card count and renders correctly
100% line and branch coverage and a clean pre-commit run
verifier: python -m python_pkg.js_anki build; pytest python_pkg/js_anki --cov-branch; pre-commit run
